beats: 0.13-0.30 SNAP: syringe out, held up, Happy grin; hold
1.03 left arm out, palm up; hold
1.33 JAB (event Inject): Surprised snap, shoulders and head jolt; frozen hold
1.83 BLISS snap: Happy + half Blink, arms drop, head back; hold
2.47 goes stiff, falls straight back like a plank (accelerating)
2.93 THUD (events Thud, SyringeDrop): eyes squeezed, bounce, arms and feet flop out
authoring: Original procedural keyframe animation (clips_forest.py on crowd_core / acting_core); no external motion reused

syringe_attachment.prop: ArtSource/Props/SYRINGE-ASTRA-001/SYRINGE-ASTRA-001.fbx (existing prop; origin = needle tip, long axis +Z toward the plunger)
syringe_attachment.frame: Blender pose-bone frame of the hand: origin at the wrist joint (bone head), +Y along the bone toward the fingers, +X thumb/index side, +Z palm normal
syringe_attachment.rotation_note: +90 deg about hand X: prop +Z (tip -> plunger) = hand -Y, prop +X = hand +X (flange wings across the hand), prop +Y = hand +Z (palm normal); needle along the fingers

unity_local_guess.note: standard right->left-handed X flip of the Blender bone frame; the syringe FBX has its own import axis conversion, so place it once with a gizmo

syringe_attachment.plunger: CTRL_PlungerTravel_Z local z 0.000 (out) -> -0.048 (in) during the Inject event window

face_note: keyed in the .blend as action Inject_Face (Face shape keys); not in the FBX
